name: manual_e040f9
claim: In zsh a shell variable named path is tied to PATH: assigning to it breaks every later command lookup (git: command not found, with zero counts printed as if they were results). Use another name such as fp or target in shell functions, and treat command not found inside a loop as invalidating the numbers.

decisions.notes: A content-check function assigned path and every git call failed; the zero counts looked like evidence until the error text was read.

rationale: A content-check function assigned path and every git call failed; the zero counts looked like evidence until the error text was read.
